description: This source file defines the ConfigFileWatcher class, which observes changes to a specific configuration file or directory using a file watcher. It encapsulates logic to trigger callbacks when the watched file or directory undergoes modifications.

classes.name: ConfigFileWatcher
classes.description: A class responsible for watching a specific configuration file or its parent directory for changes and invoking a callback upon relevant modifications.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer that sets up file watching on a specified URL, executing a callback when the file or directory changes.
